source_policy: Primary papers, author textbook and official simulator documentation only; summaries rather than archived copyrighted full text.

sources.title: Adaptive Exponential Integrate-and-Fire Model as an Effective Description of Neuronal Activity
sources.supports: Original two-dimensional AdEx model; no packing novelty claim.

sources.title: Neuronal Dynamics6.1: Adaptive Exponential Integrate-and-Fire
sources.supports: Coupled voltage/adaptation equations, exponential term, voltage reset and adaptation jump.

sources.title: Firing patterns in the adaptive exponential integrate-and-fire model
sources.supports: Two-state/reset model and parameter-dependent firing patterns; author-hosted primary paper.

sources.title: Brian2 Naud_et_al_2008_adex_firing_patterns official example
sources.supports: Eight complete adapted parameter sets, Euler0.1ms,0.6s, threshold/reset and initial conditions; plotting clipping is not the dynamics.

sources.title: NEST aeif_psc_exp
sources.supports: Filtered excitatory/inhibitory current states and adaptive RKF solver; refractory/within-step spike distinction.

sources.title: NEST aeif_cond_exp
sources.supports: Conductance states and voltage-dependent synaptic products.

sources.title: NeuroFlow: A General Purpose Spiking Neural Network Simulation Platform using Customizable Processors
sources.supports: Established FPGA AdEx support, floating-point neuron kernel and separate synaptic integration; not a reproduced local cost baseline.

sources.title: DSP-Packing: Squeezing Low-precision Arithmetic into FPGA DSP Blocks
sources.supports: Packed low-precision arithmetic and packed SNN additions are established.

sources.title: Arithmetic Packing on Wide Integer Datapaths in DSP Primitives of Modern FPGA Devices
sources.supports: Signed pre-adder packing and exact external spill tracking for MAC; reviewed sectionIII, not identified as an actual-membrane admission controller.
